title: Happy Double Ninth Festival
text: It is the Double Ninth Festival today.
Do you know the Double Ninth Festival, Tina?
Yes, it's a day for old people. It's on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month.
What do people do on this day?
They show their love for their grandmothers and grandfathers. They give them gifts and do chores for them.
What should we do for Grandpa?
We can cook dinner for him.
Good idea! We can make a card for him too.
